name: application-care-timeline
title: Care Timeline
description: A vertical patient-history timeline with clinician avatars, color-coded visit-type badges (checkup, lab work, prescription, procedure), dates, and clinical notes.
useWhen: Displaying a patient's chronological visit history in a healthcare or telehealth application.
Each entry needs a provider identity, a visit-type classification, and optional clinical notes together.
avoidWhen: The events aren't clinical/patient-specific — use the generic `timelines` component for milestone or general activity history.
You need editable structured medical records rather than a read-only chronological view — this is a display pattern, not a records-management UI.
responsiveBehavior: The vertical rail and entries stack in a single column at all widths; the connecting line and avatar column keep a fixed offset regardless of container width.
accessibility: The timeline is a real ordered list (<ol>) since visit order is chronologically meaningful.
Each visit-type badge uses both a distinct color and text label (Checkup, Lab work, Prescription, Procedure), not color alone.
Clinician initials in the avatar are paired with the full name as text beside it, so the avatar isn't the only identifying information.

variants.title: Patient history
variants.description: A four-visit care timeline (Checkup, Lab work, Prescription, Procedure) with clinician avatars, color-coded type badges, dates, and notes connected by a vertical rail.
accessibility: Each entry's clinician name, visit type, and date are all rendered as visible text.

variants.title: Patient history (Dark)
variants.description: Care timeline adapted for dark surfaces, with visit-type badge colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Avatar, badge, and note text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
